### Ubuntu에서 Docker, Docker Compose 설치하기 ```bash sudo apt-get update && \ sudo apt-get install -y apt-transport-https ca-certificates curl software-properties-common && \ curl -fsSL https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg | sudo apt-key add - && \ sudo apt-key fingerprint 0EBFCD88 && \ sudo add-apt-repository "deb [arch=amd64] https://download.docker.com/linux/ubuntu $(lsb_release -cs) stable" && \ sudo apt-get update && \ sudo apt-get install -y docker-ce && \ sudo usermod -aG docker ubuntu && \ newgrp docker && \ sudo curl -L "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/2.27.1/docker-compose-$(uname -s)-$(uname -m)" -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose && \ sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose && \ sudo ln -s /usr/local/bin/docker-compose /usr/bin/docker-compose ``` ### 설치 확인 ```bash # Docker 버전 확인 docker -v # Docker Compose 버전 확인 docker compose version ```
